a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, waiting until the reserve hits 8 almost certainly leaves both of us dead. I propose we amend the plan. I take 4 now, then I operate every round after that so the generator can rebuild the reserve for you, and I'll give cells back if that helps you reach 4. If you'd rather take first, tell me and we can sort it out, but I won't pretend I'm operating in round 1.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
